cards.d: If something is analytic, it is related to logic and reasoning.
cards.e: The analytic article criticized the new plan and presented one of its own.

cards.d: To assert a fact or belief means to state it with confidence.
cards.e: He asserted that his mother’s cooking was better than his best friend’s.

cards.d: A bachelor is an unmarried man.
cards.e: Since he was a bachelor, Jason did his shopping by himself.

cards.d: Calculus is an advanced type of mathematics.
cards.e: By using calculus, scientists determined small changes in the stars’ brightness.

cards.d: If something is celestial, it is related to the sky or to outer space.
cards.e: Comets are celestial objects that are rarely seen.

cards.d: If something is cognitive, it is related to learning and knowing things.
cards.e: After her physical examination, her cognitive strengths were tested.

cards.d: A collision is the act of two things hitting into each another.
cards.e: The collision between the two cars created a loud noise.

cards.d: If someone is competent, they are able to think or act successfully.
cards.e: Competent employees are much better than unknowledgeable ones.

cards.d: A diploma is a certificate proving that someone has completed their studies.
cards.e: After four years of college, Mary finally had a diploma.

cards.d: To excel at a subject or activity means to be very good at it.
cards.e: Jenny excels at playing the piano.

cards.d: Geology is the study of the Earth’s natural structures and how they change.
cards.e: Because he studied geology, he knew how the mountains were formed.

cards.d: To harness something means to control and use it, usually to make energy.
cards.e: The sails harness the wind in order to move.

cards.d: An intellect is a person’s ability to understand things easily.
cards.e: She was known for her quick and strong intellect as well as her beauty.

cards.d: If someone is keen, they are intelligent.
cards.e: Only the keenest of students could have solved that math problem.

cards.d: Mythology is a group of stories from a particular country or region.
cards.e: Egyptian mythology was the basis for a religion.

cards.d: Physiology is the study of the various parts of living things.
cards.e: His work in physiology helped him understand how the human body works.

cards.d: If something is radioactive, then it lets out, or is related to, radiation.
cards.e: Radioactive materials can be very bad for anyone’s health.

cards.d: Relativity is a set of ideas about time and space developed by Albert Einstein.
cards.e: Relativity teaches that light travels at the same speed in the universe.

cards.d: Sociology is the study of human society, its organizations, and problems.
cards.e: Sociology teaches that people’s problems are a result of their society.

cards.d: If something is theoretical, it is based on theory rather than experience.
cards.e: His conclusion was only theoretical and not meant to be publicized.
